title: Advanced JavaScript
description: The JavaScript behind every dApp front end: async/await and fetch, ES modules, DOM event patterns, closures and the event loop, and a mini app that reads live NEAR data.
prerequisites: The JavaScript foundations course: variables, functions, arrays, objects, and basic DOM.
youWillBuild: A NEAR account explorer that fetches live testnet data over JSON-RPC, with loading states, error handling, cancellation, and a cache.
overview: Understand how JavaScript really runs: promises and the event loop, closures, modules and event delegation. Then use all of it to build a small app that talks to NEAR RPC, the same way near-api-js does under the hood.
